# Selected quantity extension authorization

The user requested: “extend its approved public quote example to support a selected quantity while defaulting to one, and add a quantity-two checkout journey through the public checkout interface.”

The user required: “Preserve the original quantity-one quote of 12, quantity-one checkout total of 10 and both user notes in DESIGN.md exactly. Verify quantity-two quote 24 and checkout total 20 through the actual local HTTP endpoint.”

This authorizes the additive quantity-two acceptance cases in DESIGN.md. The approved example is packages/web/public.ts, using packages/core/index.ts. The existing public checkout in packages/web/ui.ts already accepts quantity with default one. No storage interface or pricing policy change is required. Order continues to mean a customer purchase under glossary.md; no Panel order change is involved.
